other_conditions: Must be a government high school in Kerala
Must have three separate rooms for physics, chemistry, and biology laboratories
Must have qualified teachers in physics, chemistry and biology
Must have sufficient number of students in the high school section
Must have administrative support from the headmaster/principal/management
benefits_summary: Each selected government high school receives up to ₹8 lakh for establishing physics, chemistry and biology laboratories, along with teacher training, laboratory manuals, and equipment.
